name: D_gen9_bench
description: A general-purpose generation benchmark that provides prompts and reference outputs to evaluate open-ended text generation quality across multiple dimensions (coherence, relevance, factuality). It is used to assess model fluency and alignment with reference responses using both automatic metrics and human judgments.
evaluation_method: automatic metrics (BLEU/ROUGE) and human_eval for quality/factuality
reputation: A small community dataset for evaluating text generation with limited visibility compared to major generation benchmarks.
